title: What Should a PDF Copy Watermark Say? Name Its Purpose
description: Choose purpose, recipient and date wording for a PDF copy watermark on iPhone, then check readability and the exact recipient copy before sharing.
direct: Say why the PDF copy exists. Add a recipient or date only when it helps identify the copy and you can share that information safely.

cards.choice.heading: Keep the text specific
cards.choice.body: Confirm what the recipient needs before sending personal documents. Use the organization’s correct name and the actual issue date. Do not include extra sensitive information in the mark. A watermark labels a copy; it does not technically prevent editing, copying or misuse.
sections.explain.heading: Make a separate copy per recipient
sections.explain.body: If you send the same source to another organization, create a new marked version rather than reusing a copy with the wrong name. Save a simple record of which file you sent and when. Do not alter an original signed document or physical identity document just to add a label.
sections.practice.heading: Check acceptance before delivery
sections.practice.body: Watermarking runs on device without an account or document upload; export tools require Pro. Its current listing supports editable watermark text and page previews. A purpose mark is not redaction, encryption or a guarantee that the recipient accepts the document. Ask about their requirements when a mark could obscure a barcode, signature or other required field.
faqs.reader-question-1.heading: What should a short purpose mark look like?
faqs.reader-question-1.body: “Rental application copy” is a clear label. Include the intended organization only if that identifier is useful and appropriate for the file.
faqs.reader-question-2.heading: Should I reuse the marked PDF for a different recipient?
faqs.reader-question-2.body: Create a new copy from the original. Check the visible text and the filename before sharing it so the other recipient’s information does not travel with it.

steps.step-1.text: Open the PDF in PDF Watermark & Stamp and enter a short purpose-specific line. Keep the unmarked original.
steps.step-2.text: Choose repeated diagonal text or a centered mark. Adjust opacity, size and color so the underlying document remains readable.
steps.step-3.text: Export the marked copy and inspect every page. Give the file a clear recipient-specific name before attaching that exact copy.
